item.title: Tor Project refuses to cut ties with Mullvad following controversial political donation
item.description: Following community outcry over a political donation by a Mullvad co-founder, the Tor Project has clarified its stance. Tor won't end its technical collaboration with the VPN provider but is dropping proactive co-branding to maintain its independence.

item.title: When your AI system breaks—and what to do about it
